title: IAEA Live Chart: 3H half-life 12.32 Y (uncertainty from the seconds column)
summary: The Live Chart row for 3H lists half-life 12.32 with unit Y. The seconds columns fix the absolute uncertainty at 0.02 years.
body: The IAEA Live Chart ground-state row for 3H (Z=1, N=2), extracted 2026-11-18, lists half_life 12.32, unit_hl Y, unc_hl 2, half_life_sec 388781328.00697345, and unc_hls 631138.51949184. Dividing half_life_sec by half_life gives 31556926 seconds per unit, so unit code Y is years in this row. Dividing unc_hls by that same number gives an absolute uncertainty of 0.02 years. The small integer unc_hl (2) matches that absolute uncertainty as 2 in the last significant place of the printed half-life, not as 2 years on its own. The leading decay field is B- at 100 percent. The row's ENSDF publication cut-off field is 30-Jun-2015. This is the database row, not a new laboratory measurement made for this card.

sources.title: IAEA Live Chart ground state 3H
sources.author: International Atomic Energy Agency, Live Chart of Nuclides

history.note: Truth gate ceiling. The only source host is iaea.org, class other, whose ceiling is weak. The Live Chart row was not changed and no source was added.

Linked the October 2023 NNDC wallet-card half-life world.physics.nndc-h-3-half-life. The IAEA numerals in this card were not rewritten. iaea.org remains class other, so this card's evidence stays weak.
